# Design DNA in OpenAI Codex

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/codex.json -->

## Install

### Codex CLI, IDE extension and app: skill folder

Method: skill folder. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna && cd design-dna
python install.py install --target codex            # user scope: ~/.agents/skills/reverse-design
python install.py install --target codex --scope project --project <your project>   # .agents/skills/reverse-design
```

Add `--dry-run` to see the changes first. The installer also runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` (skip with `--no-deps`). Without the installer, unzip [design-dna-skill.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-skill.zip) into `~/.agents/skills/`.

### Codex plugin from a local marketplace

Method: plugin / extension. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

1. python install.py install --target codex --method plugin
2. This builds ~/design-dna/hosts/codex-marketplace and, when codex is on PATH, runs: codex plugin marketplace add <that folder>, then codex plugin add design-dna@design-dna-local

Package: [design-dna-codex-plugin.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-codex-plugin.zip) (or `python install.py package --target codex-plugin`).

## Where the host looks

| Scope | Folders this host reads (from its documentation) |
|---|---|
| user | `~/.agents/skills`, `/etc/codex/skills` |
| project | `.agents/skills` |

If two of these folders hold `reverse-design`, the host picks one by its own precedence rules. `python install.py doctor --target codex` lists every copy it can see.

## Prerequisites

- Codex CLI, IDE extension or app, signed in
- Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine (python install.py doctor)

## Check, update, remove

```bash
python install.py doctor --target codex      # Python, packages, Chromium, store, visible copies
python install.py update --target codex      # refresh from this checkout (git pull first)
python install.py uninstall --target codex   # only unmodified copies it installed; templates are kept
```

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
